title: The Cutest Primate Has Venom in Its Elbows. It Can Kill
subject: slow loris

scenes.text: This adorable animal has venom hidden in its elbows.
It's a slow loris, the only venomous primate.
It makes a toxin in a gland inside its elbow.
It licks the gland, mixes the toxin with its saliva, and bites.
Its teeth are so tight that venom crawls up them into the wound.
A bite can cause anaphylactic shock. Cute isn't safe.

description:
This adorable animal has venom hidden in its elbows.
The slow loris makes a toxin in a gland on its elbow, licks it into its mouth and delivers it in a bite.
Did you think cute animals can't be dangerous?
